parrafo.es: The Sanctuary Day Spa es un spa de servicio completo sobre W Beach St en Tampa, fundado por las esteticistas Heather Funk y AnnaMarie Caras. Faciales, masajes, tratamientos corporales, dermaplaning, microneedling, depilación con cera y azúcar, y servicio de uñas, con un equipo de 12 especialistas y una calificación de 5.0 en 928 reseñas de Google.
parrafo.en: The Sanctuary Day Spa is a full-service spa on W Beach St in Tampa, founded by estheticians Heather Funk and AnnaMarie Caras. Facials, massage, body treatments, dermaplaning, microneedling, waxing, sugaring and nail services, with a 12-person team and a 5.0 rating across 928 Google reviews.

hero.imagen_alt: Zen lounge at The Sanctuary Day Spa in Tampa, with woven rattan chairs and a stone Buddha bust

parrafo_1.es: Heather Funk, fundadora de The Sanctuary Day Spa, y AnnaMarie Caras, propietaria de Enchanteria Day Spa, unieron fuerzas para crear este oasis en el barrio de Tampa. Hoy dirigen un equipo de 12 especialistas: esteticistas, masajistas, técnicas de uñas y una educadora maestra en estética.
parrafo_1.en: Heather Funk, founder of The Sanctuary Day Spa, and AnnaMarie Caras, owner of Enchanteria Day Spa, joined forces to build this neighborhood oasis in Tampa. Today they lead a 12-person team of estheticians, massage therapists, nail technicians and a master esthetics educator.

parrafo_2.es: Su misión, tal como la cuentan ellas mismas, es crear un retiro de barrio que sea un spa 'como en casa', donde puedas simplemente entrar y ser tú misma. Con una calificación de 5.0 y 928 reseñas en Google, el trabajo diario respalda esa promesa.
parrafo_2.en: Their mission, in their own words, is to create a neighborhood retreat that is a spa 'home away from home,' where you can drop in and just be yourself. With a 5.0 rating and 928 reviews on Google, the day-to-day work backs up that promise.

texto.es: Facial anti-edad con microdermabrasión de rostro, cuello y escote, dermaplaning, extracciones, terapia LED, nano therapy y mascarilla cryo lift off, finalizado con productos a tu medida.
texto.en: This anti-aging facial includes microdermabrasion of face, neck and decollete and/or dermaplaning, extractions, LED light therapy, nano therapy and a cryo lift off mask, finished with custom products for your skin.

texto.en: Body treatment, massage, hot oil scalp massage, facial, manicure and pedicure, with a charcuterie plate and drinks included.
